modern: Consider that everything that happens, happens justly, and if you observe carefully, you will find it to be so. I do not mean only with respect to the continuity of the series of things, but with respect to what is just, and as if it were done by one who gives each thing its due value. Observe, then, as you have begun; and whatever you do, do it together with this: being good, in the sense in which a man is properly understood to be good. Keep to this in every action.
original: Consider that everything which happens, happens justly, and if thou observest carefully, thou wilt find it to be so. I do not say only with respect to the continuity of the series of things, but with respect to what is just, and as if it were done by one who assigns to each thing its value. Observe then as thou hast begun; and whatever thou doest, do it in conjunction with this, the being good, and in the sense in which a man is properly understood to be good. Keep to this in every action.
